rheostatics.bio: Toronto art-rock band Rheostatics has spent decades pushing Canadian rock through progressive, orchestral, psychedelic and experimental songwriting while drawing deeply on Canadian culture and landscape.

river tiber.bio: Toronto singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and producer River Tiber, born Tommy Paxton-Beesley, makes textured alternative R&B and has contributed to music by artists including Drake, Travis Scott and BADBADNOTGOOD.

ruby waters.bio: Shelburne, Ontario singer-songwriter Ruby Waters mixes raw, bluesy alternative rock with folk and pop, pairing commanding vocals with introspective writing.

ruben young.bio: Calgary R&B and soul singer-songwriter Ruben Young has built an independent Canadian catalogue around smooth vocals, contemporary soul and collaborations with artists and producers across hip-hop and R&B.

shantel may.bio: Toronto-born R&B singer-songwriter Shantel May pairs soulful vocals with contemporary production and candid relationship writing across a growing independent catalogue.

snow.bio: Toronto-born Canadian reggae and hip-hop artist Snow, born Darrin O'Brien, became an international crossover figure with the 1993 No. 1 hit Informer and later continued working across reggae, dancehall and rap.

sofia camara.bio: Portuguese-Canadian singer-songwriter Sofia Camara, raised in Toronto, makes emotionally direct pop and R&B built around guitar, vocals and confessional songwriting.

swamp thing.bio: Toronto hip-hop trio Swamp Thing brings together Timbuktu, Chokeules and Savilion for dark, B-movie-inspired underground rap built around boom-bap production and horror and sci-fi imagery.
